# Performance · database

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-blocks.mjs from scripts/blocks-meta.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

### Indexing
- What: Add lookup structures to the database so searches do not scan every row.
- Applies when: tables have grown and lookups are slow.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### N+1 queries
- What: The slowdown when a list runs one database query per item instead of one for all.
- Applies when: lists show related data from the database.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: Loading a list runs a small, fixed number of queries, not one per item. A test counts them.

### Query plans (EXPLAIN)
- What: Ask the database how it will run a query, to see why it is slow.
- Applies when: a specific query is slow.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: practice

### Connection pooling
- What: Reuse a small set of database connections instead of opening a new one per request.
- Applies when: the app is live and opens many database connections.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Read replicas
- What: Copies of the database that take the reading load off the main one.
- Applies when: reads overload one database.
- Stage: at-scale
- Kind: checkable

### Materialized views
- What: Store the result of an expensive query and refresh it from time to time.
- Applies when: an expensive report is read often.
- Stage: at-scale
- Kind: checkable

### Bulk operations
- What: Write many rows in one go instead of one at a time.
- Applies when: the app writes many rows at once.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Pagination
- What: Load long lists one page at a time.
- Applies when: a list can grow long.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: Long lists load a page at a time. No request returns every row.
